name: tradethesis-course-builder-tiptap
description: Self-hosted isolated Tiptap prototype for TradeThesis Course Builder

scripts.test: npm run test:sidecar && npm run test:markdown-core && npm run test:markdown-references && npm run test:markdown-assets && npm run test:markdown-code && npm run test:markdown-course
scripts.test:markdown-basic: node --test --test-name-pattern='Markdown round-trip preserves common lesson formatting|GitHub-Flavored Markdown tables parse into structured table nodes|TradeThesis reference markers parse to typed nodes and serialize unchanged|unknown TradeThesis markers are retained as explicit legacy nodes|asset-backed Markdown images retain their stable asset ID|JSON-only TradeThesis blocks survive as typed references and block lossy Markdown export|reference-looking text inside inline and fenced code stays code' test/markdown-roundtrip.test.js
scripts.test:markdown-course: node --test --test-name-pattern='Bollinger Bands course source parses and round-trips without losing lesson structure' test/markdown-roundtrip.test.js
scripts.test:markdown-core: node --test --test-name-pattern='Markdown round-trip preserves common lesson formatting|GitHub-Flavored Markdown tables parse into structured table nodes' test/markdown-roundtrip.test.js
scripts.test:markdown-references: node --test --test-name-pattern='TradeThesis reference markers parse to typed nodes and serialize unchanged|unknown TradeThesis markers are retained as explicit legacy nodes' test/markdown-roundtrip.test.js
scripts.test:markdown-assets: node --test --test-name-pattern='asset-backed Markdown images retain their stable asset ID|JSON-only TradeThesis blocks survive as typed references and block lossy Markdown export' test/markdown-roundtrip.test.js
scripts.test:markdown-code: node --test --test-name-pattern='reference-looking text inside inline and fenced code stays code' test/markdown-roundtrip.test.js
